strings.en: I can't drag Lieutenant Katina down!
As a member of the Octo Squad, I'll do what I can!
Please, let this take you down!
I can reach it from here!
I'll show you the power of the reborn/　Gespenst Mk-II!
This Type C should be able to do it!
I'll pull this off with the Type C!
That man... he's a dangerous type...!
With that personality, he should leave openings...!
Jua-Mu, I can't back down either!
Fu-Ruu... I can't let my guard down!
Beat him, and this battle ends!
Whatever their goal, if they attack...!
I won't let the Golaikunru mercenaries/　do as they please!
Against someone like that,/　I'll fight like Lieutenant Katina!
In a way, that type's scarier than Lieutenant Katina...!
To reach the Rabulpaila,/　we have to break through here!
The Cross Gate.../　We can't hand over something that dangerous!
I won't be fooled by looks!
If it's a Dark Brain remnant,/　I can't let my guard down!
I'll try aiming at the soft-looking parts of its skin!
It can control Zovorg mobile weapons too...!
I've fought plenty of Yokijin before!
Skull Knight... I have to create an opening somehow!
If we lose here, the Earth Sphere will...!
I can't run away!/　For the people of Earth!
XN-L! The answer you reached is wrong!
XN-L! I'll take you down here, no matter what!
We're used to fighting/　Zovorg units too!
Golaikunru's goal is clear enough, but...!
Geios-Grude... Mass-produced or not,/　I can't let my guard down.
I won't flinch, even at a high-performance Zovorg unit!
It's tough, but I've fought it before.../　I'll find a way!
Commander unit or not, I won't flinch!
I can't let you through here!
Those moves... is that really a Zovorg mobile weapon?
New model or not, it must have a weakness!
Big Shoulder... I'll take it down!
Leave that White Horn to me!
Against a Thorn,/　I have to be careful to a fault...!
Raftclans.../　Tough enemy or not, there has to be a way!
Secure a path for the Hagane and Hiryu Custom!!
Can I even lock onto that...!?
Whatever monster I face,/　I can't afford to lose...!
To reduce the damage to the city, even a little!
We can't spend time on the Lamaris!
I'll wipe them out before they spawn!
Even a combined Lamaris, if we concentrate fire...!
So it's a combination of Lamaris Kaana...!
For Lieutenant Arieil's sake,/　I'll hold it back as much as I can!
I won't let the Ares Geist become a vessel!
I'll take it down for the Lieutenant...!
Even Lieutenant Katina has weak spots...
I won't let it end like this!
If I can, I'll end it next turn...!
Not yet! This is where it starts!
Don't think things'll go your way...!
Whoa! At this rate, I'm done for...!
Ugh! Am I just waiting here to die...!?
Wh-What!? It hit the power plant...!?
I-I can't believe one bad call/　cost me this much...!
Gah! I-I'm not giving up yet...!
Not yet! The real test starts now!
Ugh! H-Hold out a little longer...!
P-Purging damaged armor...!/　One more hit and I'm finished...!?
I-I guess not getting shot down/　is something, at least...!?
Is the Gespenst's armor/　already at its limit...!?
I'll show the pride of a Gespenst pilot!
Ugh.../　I can't go down until Gu-Landon's defeated...!
Against the Fury,/　I can't fall yet!!
Managed to avoid a direct hit...
I'm not weak enough to fall to this...!
Gah! Taking more hits is dangerous...!!
Checking damage.../　The unit's not in great shape...
Compared to Lieutenant Katina's yelling,/　this is nothing!
Damn it! Like this,/　I'll just drag the lieutenant down...!
This unit won't stop working/　over damage like this.
Ngh! If I handled it better,/　I wouldn't be getting hit...!
Wh-Whoa!/　They actually hit this unit!?
Do they know/　the Gespenst's weak points after all...!?
I can't let Jua-Mu set the pace...!
If I go soft, Karo-Ran will take advantage...!
I'll endure even the Zee-Gadin's attacks!
If they keep using the Cross Gate like this...!
A direct hit from the Crystal Dragoon...!
If we yield to XN-L, Earth will...!
Ugh! If I get bogged down by the Lamaris here...!
I-I won't be overwhelmed by a Kaana Type...!
Wh-What did that monster just do!?
I knew I couldn't do it/　like Lieutenant Katina...!
That doesn't even count as a hit...!
Ngh...! I won't back down over this!
If I run now,/　the Lieutenant will chew me out...!
If I can keep the damage to a minimum!
With damage this light.../　I can fight more boldly.
Just a little shake. Heavy armor indeed.
It's built for mobility,/　but it can still hold out...!
I couldn't dodge in this machine...!
A Gespenst can handle some recklessness!
With the Type Haken's durability, this is nothing!
I can't lose to someone who enjoys fighting!
Can't shake off/　Al-Van that easily...!
My training wasn't so soft/　that this would make me bleed!
Distracted by controlling the Cross Gate?
Is Skull Knight still/　not getting serious...?!
No matter how strong XN-L is...!
Knowing its specs makes it easier to counter!
Ugh, caught in the Zeranio-class's line of fire!
Beating the unknowns comes/　before worrying about hits!
The Lamaris got its teeth into me...!
Even combined, if this is all...!
If the Ida Type keeps targeting me...!
Ugh, Yokijin are hard to read...!
If I stay calm and watch its moves...!
I didn't survive this long on just luck!
You underestimated the Type Haken's response!
I can't let Jua-Mu set the pace!
With this, I can fight even the Raftclans!
I can't get hit by the Zee-Gadin's attacks...!
Do you think this is a game, Gomoudokka?!
If I stay calm, even the/　Crystal Dragoon's attacks...!
Even against Skull Knight, if I keep this up...!
If I take a direct hit from XN-L...!
All right! I'll draw the Lamaris here!
I won't take a hit from the Kaana!
Compared to Lieutenant Katina,/　this one's not so bad...?
I managed to get past it...
That might have been a feint./　I need to watch for the real attack...!
I've got a Jammer on my side!
Ngh, I need to reload, fast!
One more push will do it!
I won't let this chance slip away!
Lieutenant Katina!/　You're too far forward!
All right...!/　That's the Lieutenant's usual timing!
I have to keep up with Lieutenant Katina!
Radha, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Leona, leave the rest to me!
L-Lieutenant Tasuku!/　Where are you going?!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Aqua, I'll take it from here!
Ing, leave the rest to me!
Arieil, I'll take it from here!
Michiru, leave the rest to me!
Major Sänger, I'll back you up!
Major Kai, I'll take it from here!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'll back you up!
I'll back up the SRX Team!
Lüne, leave the rest to me!
Princess, leave the rest to me!
Touya, I'll take it from here!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Lieutenant Katina!/　Don't charge ahead on your own!
Lieutenant Katina! Enemy on your left!!
I won't let them get the Lieutenant!
Arado, don't you see the enemy?!
I won't let them take the Hiryu Custom!
Rim, get out of here, now!
Major Kai, leave this to me!
Major Gilliam, leave this to me!
Masaki, get out of here, quick!
Touya, get out of there now!
Akimi, don't get too far ahead, it's dangerous!
Heavy armor or not, stay alert, Akemi!
Just like Lieutenant Katina.../　I'll go all out!!
It may be tricky to handle,/　but I'll pull it off!
This thing packs a mean kick too!
If I can just get in range!!
A fist worthy of Lieutenant Katina.../　Take this!!
If I stay calm and aim...!
All right, I've got a lock!
Oxtongue Rifle, set to W Mode!
No being cautious with this thing./　I've got to be bold!
All right...! It's now or never!
As long as I use it at the right moment!
It looks tough to handle.../　but I've got no choice!
A fist trained by Lieutenant Katina!
I won't let any of you escape!
Time to show what artillery can do!
I can't let this Missile go to waste!
This Missile's expensive,/　I've gotta be Cautious with it...!
This thing's fists rival Lieutenant Katina's!
Even if it's a little reckless...!
This power... just what you'd expect from the Boxer!
If this keeps up, we're fine!
If I land a direct hit... I win!
Basically the same as a normal Ripper!
With this weapon,/　my patterns should be harder to read!
Don't let being forgettable get you down, Mr. Plain.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
This is how I do it!
Plain is plain after all! My bad!
One clean cut... I can do it too!
I'll show you the Gun Stabblader's/　combination!
If I use the Cylion's acceleration!
If I can get into its blind spot!
Blade work taught by Lieutenant Katina!
If I can stop its movement!
If I concentrate the Varga's firepower!
